title: Anduril reportedly in talks to raise funding at $100B valuation, more than 3x last year’s mark
summary: Anduril is said to be raising a new round of funding that may push its valuation up to about $100 billion, per Reuters.
llm_summary: Anduril, a defense technology company, is reportedly in talks to secure a new round of funding that could take its valuation to a staggering $100 billion. This would be a significant increase from its valuation last year, which was around $30 billion. This development could give Anduril the resources it needs to further expand its operations and offerings in the defense technology space.
